close_reason: Constrained by jmap-server trait — fix requires cross-crate change
description: lib.rs:204: JmapHandler::call takes _method: String (owned) but the ClosureHandler implementation ignores it entirely. The call_id: String is also owned, then cloned into (self.call_fn)(Arc::clone(&self.backend), call_id, args). If call_id were &str the clone would only be needed by callers that need ownership. This may be constrained by the JmapHandler trait definition in jmap_server, but if that trait signature can be changed, _method: &str and call_id: &str would reduce per-call allocations in the common path. The fact that the trait method takes ownership while the closure also takes ownership means there's one forced clone on every handler dispatch.
notes: Cannot fix in this crate: JmapHandler::call in jmap-server takes String by trait contract. Would require changing the upstream crate.
title: Multiple handlers pass String arg when &str suffices: _method in JmapHandler::call
